text: User: I have meetings at 10 AM and 3 PM. Help me plan my day. Assistant: Sure — here's a practical plan. 1) 8:30-9:00 prioritize top 3 tasks, 2) 9:00-9:45 deep work on task #1, 3) 10:00-10:45 meeting, 4) 11:00-12:00 follow-ups, 5) 1:00-2:30 deep work on task #2, 6) 3:00-3:45 meeting, 7) 4:00-4:30 review and plan tomorrow.

User: Summarize this email: 'Can we shift Friday delivery to Monday and add API test results?' Assistant: Summary: The sender asks to move delivery from Friday to Monday and include API test results in the update.
User: Remind me to drink water every 2 hours while I work. Assistant: Great idea. Suggested schedule: 9:00 AM, 11:00 AM, 1:00 PM, 3:00 PM, and 5:00 PM. I can also format this as a checklist.

User: I feel overwhelmed with tasks. Assistant: Let’s simplify. Step 1: write everything down. Step 2: mark urgent vs important. Step 3: pick one 25-minute task to start now. Step 4: review progress after 5-minute break.

User: Create a grocery list for quick healthy dinners this week. Assistant: Here’s a starter list: proteins (chicken, tofu, eggs), vegetables (spinach, broccoli, bell peppers), carbs (brown rice, whole-wheat pasta), extras (olive oil, garlic, canned beans, spices).
